scope: All 50 PRs of the Martian Code Review Bench offline set, assembled from three runs over disjoint selections: 20 held-out PRs (entries 1, 2, 4, 5 of each repository's golden file), the 5 development PRs (entry 3), and the remaining 25 (entries 6-10). One attempt per PR. No review or judge call was repeated.
review_settings: Shipping defaults (review.second_look off); empty isolated index; one attempt per PR; 900 s cap per review (420 s for the development run); 3 concurrent reviews

runs.label: held_out
runs.selection_rule: Entries 1,2,4,5 of each of the five repositories in the pinned upstream golden-file order. Fixed before reviews; no selection by findings or competitor performance.

runs.label: dev
runs.selection_rule: Third entry of each of the five repositories in the pinned upstream golden-file order. Fixed before reviews. No selection by findings or competitor performance. One case per language; not a representative full-benchmark estimate.

runs.label: rest
runs.selection_rule: Entries 6,7,8,9,10 of each of the five repositories in the pinned upstream golden-file order. Fixed before reviews; no selection by findings or competitor performance.

chart_subtitle: Same PRs and judge for every reviewer; competitor reviews as published · Nov 2026
method: Pinned local source snapshots at each PR's head commit; Mira reviewed each PR once through its full pipeline with no index, learned rules or history. Matching and deduplication use the upstream benchmark's prompts with Claude Sonnet 4.5; competitor rows are the upstream's published evaluations of the same PRs under the same judge and were not rerun. Unmatched findings count as false positives even where the reference set may omit a valid issue. Competitors publish no timings.
